description_en: Updates the features of a fleet
name: UpdateHubClusterFeature

parameters.help_en: The fleet ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424404.html operation to query the IDs of fleet instances
parameters.help_zh: 舰队ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424404.html接口获取已创建的舰队Fleet实例的ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The fleet name. The name must be 1 to 63 characters in length and can contain letters and digits. It must start with a letter and can contain digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 舰队名称。长度为[1, 63]个英文或数字字符。必须以大小字母开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable audit logging. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启审计日志。
true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: audit_log_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Alibaba Cloud Service Mesh (ASM). Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启服务网格（ASM）。

true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_mesh

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the fleet. If deletion protection is enabled, the fleet cannot be deleted in the console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424406.html operation. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
集群删除保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424406.html删除集群。

true：开启集群删除保护。
false：关闭集群删除保护。

默认值：false
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to attach a public IP address to the API server. Valid values:

true: Attaches a public Elastic IP Address (EIP). You can specify the ApiServerEipId parameter to use an existing EIP. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses automatic creation of an EIP instance.
false: Detaches the public EIP
parameters.help_zh:
是否为API Server绑定公网入口。

true： 绑定公网EIP，需要绑定的时候，可以自行指定ApiServerEipId参数，若不传入，则系统会自动创建一个EIP实例。
false： 解绑公网EIP
parameters.name: public_api_server_enabled

parameters.help_en: The EIP instance ID
parameters.help_zh: EIP实例ID
parameters.name: api_server_eip_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable ArgoCD. This parameter takes effect only when Profile is set to XFlow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html operation to query the Profile parameter. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用ArgoCD。仅当Profile为XFlow时生效。Profile参数可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html接口查看。

本参数取值如下：
true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: argo_cd_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the workflow instance UI. This parameter takes effect only when Profile is set to XFlow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html operation to query the Profile parameter. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用工作流实例UI。仅当Profile为XFlow的时候生效。Profile参数可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html接口查看。

本参数取值如下：
true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: argo_server_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The workflow scheduling mode. This parameter takes effect only when Profile is set to XFlow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html operation to query the Profile parameter. Valid values:

cost-optimized: cost-optimized.
stock-optimized: inventory-optimized
parameters.help_zh:
工作流调度模式。仅当Profile为XFlow的时候生效。Profile参数可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424405.html接口查看。

本参数取值如下：
cost-optimized：成本优先。
stock-optimized：库存优先
parameters.name: workflow_schedule_mode

parameters.help_en: The price limit for workflow workloads. This parameter takes effect only when WorkflowScheduleMode is set to cost-optimized
parameters.help_zh: 工作流负载价格限制。仅当WorkflowScheduleMode取值为cost-optimized时生效
parameters.name: price_limit

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitches
parameters.help_zh: 交换机列表
parameters.name: vswitches

true：启用。
false：禁用

parameters.help_en: The access control list (ACL) for public network access. This parameter takes effect only when PublicAccessEnabled is set to true
